action_items: Fix the syntax error in /app/frontend/src/pages/Report.jsx around lines 376-393. The component's `return (...); }` appears to close prematurely, leaving the posting_schedule JSX block (and likely daily_checklist) as dangling code outside the function. Likely a misplaced `}` or missing wrapper JSX. After fix, ensure `npx eslint src/pages/Report.jsx` is clean and webpack compiles before re-running UI tests.

Re-run frontend tests after fix: (a) /share/{valid_token} renders report-page + public-pulse-logo + public-cta and no share-report-button; (b) /share/{invalid_token} shows friendly 'Link unavailable'; (c) on logged-in Report page, share-report-button opens share-dialog with share-expiry-7 -> share-url-input + copy-share-url + revoke-share; (d) ProjectDetail shows export-guide-trigger-{platform} that opens export-guide-{platform} for all 5 platforms.
